description: This is a unit test class for the EmployeeActionSummaryAPI within the OrangeHRM Dashboard Plugin, focusing on API endpoints related to employee action summaries. It includes test methods for retrieving a single record and methods for testing unimplemented API operations such as delete and update.

classes.name: EmployeeActionSummaryAPITest
classes.description: A test class for the EmployeeActionSummaryAPI, performing integration tests on API endpoints such as 'getOne' and verifying that other methods throw 'not implemented' exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single employee action summary via the API, using data providers for different test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetOne' method, loading scenarios from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that delete operation on the API correctly throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that validation rules for delete operation are not implemented and throw exceptions.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that update operation on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that validation rules for update operation are not implemented and throw exceptions.
